speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Actually, I don't have a preference, but if you make me say it, I'd go with happy music.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Although I think both kinds have a real reason to exist.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: When I'm sad, I want to listen to happy music — being sad already feels disgusting, and I need the vibe to match if I want to be emotional.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: And when I'm happy, happy music is very enjoyable.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: But if I'm happy and I listen to sad music, it just feels — wow, so out of place.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: So I think it depends on my emotion at the moment.
